name: view-customizer
title: View customizer
author: Eduardo Retana
description: A popover of view tiles you can turn on and off, plus an animated switcher that appears once two views are enabled.

meta.descriptionEs: Baldosas para encender vistas y una pastilla que aparece cuando hay dos o más.

examples.title: Vistas de la colección
examples.description: Ver todas desaparece cuando todas están encendidas.

examples.title: Marco de estrés
examples.description: Una sola vista y un pie largo.

meta.usage: <ViewSwitcher views={enabled} value={viewId} onValueChange={setViewId} menu={<ViewCustomizer views={views} enabled={enabled} onEnabledChange={setEnabled}>{trigger}</ViewCustomizer>} />

api.name: views / enabled / onEnabledChange
api.description: At least one view stays on. Show all hides when every view is on.

api.name: footer
api.description: Scope line under the tiles, such as where the choice is saved.

api.name: ViewSwitcher
api.description: Hides the pill at one view. At two or more it resizes and the add button slides.

docs: ViewSwitcher is exported from this file and builds on segmented-control. The glide uses the host motion presets and respects reduced motion. Pair it with use-multi-view enabledViews and persistViews. Answer no if the CLI asks to overwrite button or popover. The item ships no theme.
